up: Return all approved drugs (max_phase = 4) that have an indication for 'infection'. For each drug, provide the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, and the associated indication details (Mesh heading and EFO term). Join molecule_dictionary with compound_structures and drug_indication tables.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (LOWER(di.mesh_heading) LIKE '%infection%' OR LOWER(di.efo_term) LIKE '%infection%')
